_about: Field notes (release 2), headed STAFF NOTE: a new general's first battle on the field, taught as he plays it. The staff note of FIRST COMMAND (ruling 129, look ruling 147) carried onto the general's screen: one note at a time, 30 words at most, one deed, stamped DONE when he does it, never taking the controls. Kept with the player (Saved/Campaign/field-notes.json), not the save. Words for the design director and the UI director to rule; the notes run in this order, each when its moment comes. when: setup (only while he sets out his army), fight (once the clock runs), any. off: said once in the middle line when NOTES OFF is pressed (the staff notes are one switch with the Guide's). aim: what the brass corners frame (begin: BEGIN THE BATTLE; pause: PAUSE; tag: one of his units' tags; bar: the tug of war; none). keys: each key a note names and what it must do on his screen (view:N the view key's bit, pace:N, pause, do:word his GeneralDo word), and shows: the words on his screen a note names; Tools/field_notes checks both against LandBattleScreen.cpp's OnKeyDown and its buttons, and every claim's file and line is in joins/guided-start/NOTES.md (the design director 28 November 2026 23:58Z: a claim with no line comes out).
label: STAFF NOTE

notes.heading: Set out your army
notes.text: The clock waits while you place your units. Drag any of them inside the brass line. A unit set down in woods starts hidden from the enemy.
notes.deed: Place one unit, or BEGIN THE BATTLE.

notes.heading: Look over the field
notes.text: W, A, S and D, or the pointer at the screen's edge, move your view. The wheel zooms, Q and E turn, and O looks almost straight down.

notes.heading: Take your time
notes.text: SPACE pauses the battle. You can still give orders; they reach your units once it runs again. 1, 2 and 3 set the pace. Pause whenever you need to think.

notes.heading: Take a unit in hand
notes.text: Click a unit's tag over the field, or its card along the bottom. Shift-click adds another; drag a box round several. TAB finds your next unit.

notes.heading: Give an order
notes.text: With units in hand, click ground to send them there, or an enemy to attack. Click twice to go at the double. Orders go by radio and take a moment.

notes.heading: What decides it
notes.text: Nothing here is scripted. Men and machines, training, doctrine, the ground and your orders decide who holds the field. Point at a unit to see its name, kind and men.

notes.heading: Who gives up the field
notes.text: The bar between the flags weighs both sides' losses. Under it, each side's HOW NEAR TO BREAKING OFF fills as men fall and run; the first to fill falls back.
notes.deed: Let the battle run one minute.

closing.heading: The field is yours
closing.text: With a unit in hand, H holds it and R pulls it off the field. FILM watches as a camera would. Your staff fights any unit you never order.

tips.where: the attack card, under its orders, the first time it offers FIGHT IT YOURSELF
tips.text: FIGHT IT YOURSELF puts you on the field as the general; SEND THEM IN leaves it to your generals.

off: STAFF NOTES ARE OFF. THE GUIDE, ON THE CAMPAIGN MAP, TURNS THEM ON AGAIN.
